description: Your communication style says a lot about you #communicationskills #communicationtips #communicationiskey
transcript: I am a diplomatic communicator, I don't mind having tough conversations, I speak with clarity, precision, I can communicate complex ideas and details without getting emotionally invested in them direct and very clear. You can tell a lot about someone's maturity by the way that they communicate. Understanding your communication style allows you to see people for who they are.
